evidence.quote: take a standing on the shoulders of giants approach
leverage the previous work that exists

observations.why: Appeals to reusing existing work as the good, framed against rolling new constructions; the value is keeping what works rather than novelty.
Appeals to caution and stability before building, valuing a full design and test over ad hoc implementation.

evidence.quote: It's designed to never flip unless something bad happens.

observations.why: Values stability and security: an output cap should only act as a rarely triggered safeguard.

evidence.quote: A frame is not designed to be the carrier of meaning.

observations.why: Appeals to quality of design craft: meaning is read through the frame and statements together, not carried by the frame alone.

evidence.quote: What a mature engine adds is complete, benchmark-tuned primitives

observations.why: Appeals to mastery of established tooling as the mark of quality, separating what mature engines supply from domain decisions.

mints.name: ShouldersOfGiantsReuse
mints.title: take a standing on the shoulders of giants
mints.frame: Does this move reuse what prior work already built before adding a new construction?
